title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #17

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do before sleeping according to Aisha (R.A.)? (1 mark)
   A. Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   B. Recited Al-Masad three times
   C. Recited only Al-Fatiha standing
   D. Slept without any remembrance

2. How many verses does Surah Al-Fatiha have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 4

3. The name Al-Fatiha means (1 mark)
   A. The Sincerity
   B. The Opening
   C. The Victory
   D. The Cow

4. What did the Prophet say about smiling at your brother? (1 mark)
   A. It is a sin
   B. It is a kind of charity
   C. It is only for the rich
   D. It is forbidden

5. What can someone say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   B. Astaghfirullah only
   C. Allahu Akbar
   D. Nothing

6. What does "Bismillah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is the Greatest
   B. All praise is for Allah
   C. In the name of Allah
   D. Glory be to Allah

7. Which of these should you NOT do? (1 mark)
   A. Rinse your brush
   B. Replace an old brush
   C. Store the brush clean
   D. Share your toothbrush

8. Brushing teeth can become an act of worship when you (1 mark)
   A. Do it while angry
   B. Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   C. Do it to show off
   D. Do it without thinking

9. What is a good way to remember to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Forget it
   B. Leave it to the weekend
   C. Only brush when a friend does
   D. Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall

10. Which hand do we use to hold the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Left hand only
   B. Neither
   C. Right hand
   D. Both feet

11. What is a good weekly fitness plan for a child? (1 mark)
   A. About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   B. No sleep
   C. Sitting all day
   D. Only sweets

12. Which skill helps keep a person safe near water? (1 mark)
   A. Swimming
   B. Archery
   C. Singing
   D. Chess

13. Which of these is an Islamic etiquette in sport? (1 mark)
   A. Betting
   B. No insults or fighting
   C. Bad words
   D. Skipping prayer

14. What does "Ar-Rahim" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Hearing
   B. The Owner of the Day
   C. The Source of Peace
   D. The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers

15. Belief in angels is one of the pillars of (1 mark)
   A. Iman
   B. Zakat
   C. Islam only
   D. Hajj

16. Neema tells the truth instead of lying at school. Which angels' duty helped her remember? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Israfil
   C. Jibril
   D. Raqib and Atid

17. Which angel spoke to the Prophet in the cave of Hira? (1 mark)
   A. Atid
   B. Jibril
   C. Israfil
   D. Mikail

18. Which of these is NOT the correct way to treat a prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Worshipping the prophet
   B. Respecting him
   C. Following his good example
   D. Loving him

19. Which prophet is remembered for generosity to guests? (1 mark)
   A. Nuh
   B. Salih
   C. Ibrahim
   D. Yunus

20. Why must we clean najasaat before prayer? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for adults
   B. It is a game
   C. Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   D. It saves water

21. What is the main tool for removing najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Pure water
   B. Paint
   C. Perfume
   D. Oil

22. How should we treat dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Hit them
   B. Ignore hunger
   C. Cruelly
   D. Kindly, but avoid their saliva

23. If wudhu breaks during prayer, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Continue
   B. Ignore it
   C. Pray louder
   D. Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again

24. Why do Muslims all over the world face the same direction? (1 mark)
   A. To confuse others
   B. By accident
   C. For sport
   D. It unites us

25. What is tayammum? (1 mark)
   A. Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   B. A dua
   C. A type of prayer
   D. Washing with soap

26. In which direction does the sun rise? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. West
   D. South

27. In which city is the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Madinah
   C. Mombasa
   D. Makkah

28. What is taslim? (1 mark)
   A. The beginning of prayer
   B. Bowing
   C. The ending greeting of the prayer
   D. Dua

29. What is planting a tree from which animals or people eat counted as? (1 mark)
   A. Charity for the planter
   B. A waste
   C. A sin
   D. Nothing

30. Who owns all creatures? (1 mark)
   A. Zoos
   B. The government
   C. Farmers
   D. Allah

31. With which side should we start when putting on shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Right
   B. Neither
   C. Left
   D. Either

32. Which is an example of wasteful dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Repairing a shirt
   B. Buying many clothes you do not need
   C. Sharing old clothes
   D. Washing your clothes

33. What is integrity in media use? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Hiding
   C. Doing right even when nobody is watching
   D. Copying work

34. Which prophet ate from the work of his hands? (1 mark)
   A. Yunus
   B. Nuh
   C. Dawud
   D. Hud

35. What is an obligation? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A duty that must be done
   C. A punishment
   D. A gift

36. In which city was Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) born? (1 mark)
   A. Makkah
   B. Nairobi
   C. Taif
   D. Cairo

37. Who was the first young boy to accept Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Waraqa
   C. Bilal
   D. Ali

38. What is tolerance? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Insulting
   C. Ignoring
   D. Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them

39. Which angel came with the angel of the mountains? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Mikail
   C. Jibril
   D. Raqib

40. Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Mut'im ibn Adiy
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Khalid

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

42. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)

43. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

44. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

45. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

46. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

47. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

48. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

49. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)

50. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

51. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

52. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

53. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

54. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)

55. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

56. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

57. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

58. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

59. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)

60. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   This is reported in Al-Bukhari.

2. C — 7
   Al-Fatiha has seven verses.

3. B — The Opening
   Al-Fatiha means "The Opening" because it opens the Qur'an.

4. B — It is a kind of charity
   A smile that cheers someone up is charity.

5. A — Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   The Prophet taught this for one who forgets.

6. C — In the name of Allah
   Bismillah means "In the name of Allah".

7. D — Share your toothbrush
   Sharing a toothbrush spreads germs.

8. B — Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   Good intention makes daily acts worship.

9. D — Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall
   Routine builds habits.

10. C — Right hand
   The right hand is used for clean, honourable actions.

11. A — About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   Regular activity keeps fit.

12. A — Swimming
   Swimming can save lives.

13. B — No insults or fighting
   A Muslim keeps good manners on the field.

14. D — The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   Ar-Rahim is Allah's special mercy.

15. A — Iman
   The six pillars of Iman include angels.

16. D — Raqib and Atid
   They record what we say.

17. B — Jibril
   Jibril came with the first revelation.

18. A — Worshipping the prophet
   We worship Allah alone.

19. C — Ibrahim
   He served his guests a fattened calf.

20. C — Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   Prayer is not valid with najasa on the body, clothes or place.

21. A — Pure water
   Allah sends pure water from the sky.

22. D — Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   Islam teaches kindness to animals.

23. D — Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again
   Prayer needs valid wudhu.

24. D — It unites us
   The Qibla unites Muslims.

25. A — Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   It is a substitute in some cases.

26. B — East
   The sun rises in the east.

27. D — Makkah
   The Kaaba is in Makkah.

28. C — The ending greeting of the prayer
   As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullah.

29. A — Charity for the planter
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

30. D — Allah
   We are caretakers.

31. A — Right
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

32. B — Buying many clothes you do not need
   Waste is disliked.

33. C — Doing right even when nobody is watching
   Allah sees everything.

34. C — Dawud
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

35. B — A duty that must be done
   Obligation means duty.

36. A — Makkah
   He was born in Makkah.

37. D — Ali
   Ali was young and raised in the Prophet's home.

38. D — Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   He did not curse them.

39. C — Jibril
   Jibril and the angel of the mountains.

40. A — Mut'im ibn Adiy
   Traditional accounts mention Mut'im.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.
